name: LinyaShare
author: linya@sknif.de
startup: mkdir -p /home/container/prisma && cd /home/container || exit 1 && if [ ${AUTO_UPDATE:-false} = true ]; then git config --global --replace-all user.email pterodactyl@localhost && git config --global --replace-all user.name pterodactyl && git fetch origin && TARGET_BRANCH=${GIT_BRANCH:-main} && if [ $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) != $TARGET_BRANCH ]; then git checkout $TARGET_BRANCH; fi && git pull origin $TARGET_BRANCH && if git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep -q package.json; then npm install; fi; fi && git checkout HEAD -- prisma/schema.prisma && export PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} && export NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-http://${SERVER_IP:-localhost}:{{SERVER_PORT}}} && export NEXTAUTH_URL=${NEXTAUTH_URL:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL} && export AUTH_TRUST_HOST=${AUTH_TRUST_HOST:-true} && export DATABASE_PROVIDER=${DATABASE_PROVIDER:-sqlite} && if [ -z "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]; then export DATABASE_URL=file:/home/container/prisma/linyashare.db; export DATABASE_PROVIDER=sqlite; elif [ "${DATABASE_PROVIDER:-sqlite}" = "sqlite" ] && [ "${DATABASE_URL#file:}" = "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL=file:/home/container/prisma/linyashare.db; fi && echo "DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL" > .env && echo "DATABASE_PROVIDER=$DATABASE_PROVIDER" >> .env && export UPLOAD_DIR=/home/container/data/uploads && export IMPORT_DIR=/home/container/data/import && export GLOBAL_UPLOAD_DIR=/home/container/data/uploads/global && mkdir -p $UPLOAD_DIR $IMPORT_DIR && if [ "$DATABASE_PROVIDER" = "postgres" ]; then cp -f prisma/schema.postgres.prisma prisma/schema.prisma; fi; if [ "$DATABASE_PROVIDER" = "mysql" ]; then cp -f prisma/schema.mysql.prisma prisma/schema.prisma; fi; npx prisma generate && npm run build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -rf .next/static/* .next/standalone/.next/static/ 2>/dev/null || true && [ -d public ] && cp -rf public/* .next/standalone/public/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -f .env .next/standalone/.env 2>/dev/null || true && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && { npm run fonts:download || echo "[fonts] Vorab-Download fehlgeschlagen, Lazy-Download uebernimmt"; } && cp -rf node_modules/.prisma .next/standalone/node_modules/ 2>/dev/null || true && cd .next/standalone && PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL" node server.js

installation.script: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt update && apt install -y git curl ca-certificates python3 make g++ && mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server && git clone -b "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/LinyaVT/LinyaShare.git}" . && npm install

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description: URL to the LinyaShare GitHub repository.

variables.name: Auto-Update
variables.description: If 'true', pulls the latest code from GitHub on every server restart.

variables.name: NextAuth Secret
variables.description: A random secret key for session encryption.

variables.name: Public App URL
variables.description: The public URL of your instance (e.g., https://share.example.com).

variables.name: NextAuth URL
variables.description: Callback URL for Auth. Defaults to Public App URL if left empty.

variables.name: Auth Trust Host
variables.description: Set to 'true' to allow the server to trust the incoming host header.

variables.name: Database Provider
variables.description: Database backend. 'sqlite' (default, file-based, no extra server), 'mysql' (MySQL/MariaDB), or 'postgres' (PostgreSQL). For external servers also set the Database URL.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Connection string for an external database. Only needed when Database Provider is 'mysql' or 'postgres'. Examples - MySQL: mysql://user:pass@host:3306/linyashare; PostgreSQL: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/linyashare. The database must already exist. Leave empty to use the built-in SQLite database.
